description: A value whose reads are tracked and whose changes notify dependents automatically (MobX, Legend-State).
Valtio wraps an object in a JavaScript `Proxy`: you mutate it, components read immutable snapshots.
A model with a finite set of states and explicit event-driven transitions. Implemented by XState.
XState v5 treats machines as actors that receive events, keep private state and can spawn or message other actors.
Reactive primitives that push updates to subscribers. Native in Solid, Preact, Vue, Angular and proposed for JavaScript at TC39.
